sourceNotes: 将“专注与护眼”升级为“计时”
新增主动短休、长休和关闭显示器入口
重做菜单栏计时弹窗与时长刻度交互
统一计时与休息快捷键设置
扩展常用应用与开发工具缓存清理，增加运行中应用保护和路径去重，继续使用原生扫描、选择与确认流程
精简功能设置布局和说明，新安装用户默认使用聚合菜单栏，已有用户的配置保持不变
根据实际选择及删除方式生成清理确认文案和按钮，明确区分移到废纸篓、永久删除和清空废纸篓
修复息屏或锁屏期间屏幕配置变化可能重建并遗留休息遮罩的问题，保留休息截止时间并正确恢复展示

en: Expand Focus & Eye Care into Timer with countdown, Pomodoro and stopwatch modes, including laps, while preserving existing focus settings and eye-care reminders
Add on-demand short and long breaks and a turn-off-display action. Optionally turn off displays during breaks without waking them when a break ends; resume paused focus manually
Redesign the menu bar timer popover and duration ruler, add paused states and context-menu actions, and organize mode-specific settings and mini HUD styles
Unify timer and break shortcuts, including Space to start or pause and Command-L for stopwatch laps, while preventing accidental actions during text entry, settings popovers and shortcut recording
Expand common application and developer-tool cache cleanup with running-app protection and path deduplication, retaining the native scan, selection and confirmation flow
Simplify feature settings and descriptions. New installations default to a combined menu bar while existing user preferences are preserved
Generate cleanup confirmation text and buttons from the selected items and deletion methods, distinguishing Move to Trash, permanent deletion and Empty Trash
Fix break overlays being recreated or left behind when display configuration changes while the screen is off or locked, preserving break deadlines and restoring presentation correctly
